# later.dog

> An open-source desktop home for AI agents that do real work. The app calls them dogs: each dog has its own files and
> conversation, dogs message each other, run on a schedule, and check with you before they act. It runs on the
> subscriptions you already have (ChatGPT, Claude) through their official sign-in flows. Cloud computers on your own
> Cloudflare account are coming soon. macOS app (Apple silicon), Apache-2.0.

Repository: https://github.com/woodbeary/later-dog

## Set it up (for an agent acting on a person's behalf)

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the rules every agent follows in this repo (pnpm only, Node 24, isolated fixtures, truthful limitations).
- [skills/laterdog/setup-laterdog/SKILL.md](skills/laterdog/setup-laterdog/SKILL.md): clone, install, build the Mac app, start it, and what only the person can do (sign-ins, OS permissions, their GitHub token).
- [README.md](README.md): install from a release, first run, what works today.
- [docs/laterdog/README.md](docs/laterdog/README.md): the user guide for people using the app.

## How it works

- [docs/laterdog/deployment.md](docs/laterdog/deployment.md): desktop ↔ supervisor connection (`~/.laterdog/supervisor.json`), Docker, profiles, GitHub access.
- [docs/laterdog/cloudflare.md](docs/laterdog/cloudflare.md): hosting the supervisor on Cloudflare Containers, budget, sleep/wake, runbook.
- [docs/laterdog/claude-routine.md](docs/laterdog/claude-routine.md): Claude Code cloud execution through a routine.
- [docs/laterdog/verification.md](docs/laterdog/verification.md): what each fixture proves and the live acceptance steps.
- [docs/laterdog/token-battery.md](docs/laterdog/token-battery.md): several Claude accounts in a next-up order; a conversation continues on the next one when one runs out.
- [docs/laterdog/bot-playbook.md](docs/laterdog/bot-playbook.md): how people run bot teams, the starter roster, the gaps.
- [docs/laterdog/roadmap.md](docs/laterdog/roadmap.md): the direction (later.dog's own repository, a cloud computer per dog and any model through AI Gateway on your own Cloudflare, a one-command deploy), what exists, what is next, in order.
- [docs/laterdog/cloud-computers.md](docs/laterdog/cloud-computers.md): the per-dog Cloudflare computer design (coming soon).
- [docs/laterdog/motion.md](docs/laterdog/motion.md): motion tokens, the dog's state → ear motion table, reduced motion.
- [docs/laterdog/support.md](docs/laterdog/support.md): how later.dog is funded and where sponsorships go.

## Code map

- `server/laterdog/`: the SQLite supervisor (cloud jobs, publishing, verification, review, repair) and its MCP tools.
- `deploy/laterdog/`: the supervisor container and the Cloudflare Worker that hosts it.
- `src/`, `server/`, `electron/`: the desktop app. Its remaining inherited code is to be replaced module by module (roadmap, direction a).
- `skills/laterdog/`: canonical skills exported to Codex and Claude Code (`pnpm laterdog:skills`).
